name: quark-torch-eval-runner
description: Manually verify that the Quark Agent Skills system behaves correctly across the four contract categories (routing, planning, artifact, recovery). Use when maintainers need to confirm that routing, planning, artifact generation, or error recovery skills still work as expected. Trigger for "verify the skills", "smoke-test routing", "check skill behavior", or before tagging a release. This is a governance tool for skill maintainers, not for end users running model evaluation.
